metadata.question: Did nighttime light intensity across Puerto Rico decline between September 21, 2016, and September 22, 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We will use VIIRS DNB (Black Marble) Nighttime Day/Night Band for nighttime lights. These data are available daily at 15-arcsecond (~450 m) resolution. 2. Date range: Exactly 2016-09-21 and 2016-09-22 (two consecutive dates). 3. Location: Puerto Rico – we will build a small coastline-area buffer polygon to avoid striping artefacts only over water. 4. Masking: No cloud masking is needed for night band; instead, the data include a quality flag. We will mask “poor+no data” pixels using the mandatory “cfmask” layer (QE flag). 5. Logic: Compute mean radiance across Puerto Rico for each day. Compare 2016-09-22 vs 2016-09-21. If 2016-09-22 < 2016-09-21 → A (Yes). Otherwise B (No). If one collection is empty → C1. If after masking we have 0 valid pixels → C2. If result is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Geometry: Puerto Rico land mask (outline buffered 1 km inland to ignore ocean strips) pr = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017") \ .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Puerto Rico')).geometry() roi = pr.buffer(-1000) # shrink 1 km to stay over land # Data: VIIRS Black Marble daily VNP46A1 (Nighttime Day/Night Band) def get_day(yyyymmdd): col = ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG") \ .filterDate(yyyymmdd, ee.Date(yyyymmdd).advance(1, 'day')) return col d1 = get_day('2016-09-21') d2 = get_day('2016-09-22') if d1.size().getInfo() == 0 or d2.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1: Missing day collection") print("C1") exit() # VIIRS monthly product uses 'avg_rad' band (mean radiance) img1 = d1.first().select('avg_rad') img2 = d2.first().select('avg_rad') # Pixel counts after masking fill (0 = good data in this layer) def mean_rad(img, label): good = img.mask() # 1=valid count = good.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo() mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo() print(f"{label} count: {int(count)}, mean: {mean:.4f}") return mean rad1 = mean_rad(img1, "2016-09-21") rad2 = mean_rad(img2, "2016-09-22") if rad1 is None or rad2 is None: print("C3") elif rad2 < rad1: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Geometry: Puerto Rico land mask (outline buffered 1 km inland to ignore ocean strips)
pr = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017") \
         .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Puerto Rico')).geometry()
roi = pr.buffer(-1000)  # shrink 1 km to stay over land

# Data: VIIRS Black Marble daily VNP46A1 (Nighttime Day/Night Band)
def get_day(yyyymmdd):
    col = ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG") \
              .filterDate(yyyymmdd, ee.Date(yyyymmdd).advance(1, 'day'))
    return col

d1 = get_day('2016-09-21')
d2 = get_day('2016-09-22')

if d1.size().getInfo() == 0 or d2.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("C1: Missing day collection")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# VIIRS monthly product uses 'avg_rad' band (mean radiance)
img1 = d1.first().select('avg_rad')
img2 = d2.first().select('avg_rad')

# Pixel counts after masking fill (0 = good data in this layer)
def mean_rad(img, label):
    good = img.mask()  # 1=valid
    count = good.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                              geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                            geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    print(f"{label} count: {int(count)}, mean: {mean:.4f}")
    return mean

rad1 = mean_rad(img1, "2016-09-21")
rad2 = mean_rad(img2, "2016-09-22")

if rad1 is None or rad2 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif rad2 < rad1:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
